"""70B AWQ INT4 LoRA fine-tune on SciERC IE.

Base model:   Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-AWQ-INT4
Train data:   data/sft/scierc_sft_train.jsonl (1762 ex, Qwen format -> Llama conversion)
Eval data:    data/sft/scierc_sft_dev.jsonl (260 ex)
Output:       /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/70b_lora_scierc/ (adapter only, no merge)

LoRA: r=16, alpha=32, target=q/k/v/o_proj (attention only to save VRAM).
Train: 3 epochs, bs=1, grad_accum=8, lr=2e-5, cosine, fp16, gradient_checkpointing.

Usage:
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python scripts/train_lora_70b_scierc.py
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python scripts/train_lora_70b_scierc.py --dry_run
"""

# Monkey-patch: suppress gptqmodel import check (peft bug on this server)
import peft.import_utils as _piu
_piu.is_gptqmodel_available = lambda: False

import argparse
import os
import re

import torch
from datasets import load_dataset
from peft import LoraConfig
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from trl import SFTConfig, SFTTrainer


_QWEN_RE = re.compile(
    r"<\|im_start\|>system\n(?P<sys>.+?)<\|im_end\|>\s*"
    r"<\|im_start\|>user\n(?P<usr>.+?)<\|im_end\|>",
    re.DOTALL,
)


def parse_args():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--model_path", default="/root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-AWQ-INT4")
    p.add_argument("--train_data", default="/root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/data/sft/scierc_sft_train.jsonl")
    p.add_argument("--eval_data", default="/root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/data/sft/scierc_sft_dev.jsonl")
    p.add_argument("--output_dir", default="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/70b_lora_scierc")
    p.add_argument("--epochs", type=float, default=3.0)
    p.add_argument("--batch_size", type=int, default=1)
    p.add_argument("--grad_accum", type=int, default=8)
    p.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=2e-5)
    p.add_argument("--warmup_ratio", type=float, default=0.1)
    p.add_argument("--max_length", type=int, default=2048)
    p.add_argument("--lora_r", type=int, default=16)
    p.add_argument("--lora_alpha", type=int, default=32)
    p.add_argument("--lora_dropout", type=float, default=0.05)
    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    p.add_argument("--dry_run", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--dry_run_steps", type=int, default=2)
    return p.parse_args()


def build_qwen_to_llama_converter(tokenizer):
    def convert(example):
        m = _QWEN_RE.search(example["prompt"])
        if m is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Prompt does not match Qwen chat format: {example['prompt'][:200]}")
        sys_content = m.group("sys")
        usr_content = m.group("usr")
        messages = [
            {"role": "system", "content": sys_content},
            {"role": "user", "content": usr_content},
        ]
        example["prompt"] = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True,
        )
        return example
    return convert


def main():
    args = parse_args()

    report_to = "none"

    print(f"Loading tokenizer from {args.model_path}", flush=True)
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model_path, trust_remote_code=True)
    tokenizer.padding_side = "right"
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    print(f"Loading datasets train={args.train_data} eval={args.eval_data}", flush=True)
    ds = load_dataset(
        "json",
        data_files={"train": args.train_data, "validation": args.eval_data},
    )
    keep = {"prompt", "completion"}
    for split in ds.keys():
        drop_cols = [c for c in ds[split].column_names if c not in keep]
        if drop_cols:
            ds[split] = ds[split].remove_columns(drop_cols)

    convert = build_qwen_to_llama_converter(tokenizer)
    for split in ds.keys():
        ds[split] = ds[split].map(convert, desc=f"reformat-{split}")
    print(f"  train size: {len(ds['train'])}, val size: {len(ds['validation'])}", flush=True)
    print("Sample prompt (first 400 chars):", flush=True)
    print(ds["train"][0]["prompt"][:400], flush=True)

    print(f"Loading AWQ model from {args.model_path}", flush=True)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        args.model_path,
        torch_dtype=torch.float16,
        device_map="auto",
        trust_remote_code=True,
        attn_implementation="sdpa",
    )
    model.config.use_cache = False

    lora_config = LoraConfig(
        r=args.lora_r,
        lora_alpha=args.lora_alpha,
        lora_dropout=args.lora_dropout,
        bias="none",
        task_type="CAUSAL_LM",
        target_modules=["q_proj", "v_proj", "k_proj", "o_proj"],
    )

    sft_kwargs = dict(
        output_dir=args.output_dir,
        num_train_epochs=args.epochs,
        per_device_train_batch_size=args.batch_size,
        per_device_eval_batch_size=args.batch_size,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=args.grad_accum,
        gradient_checkpointing=True,
        gradient_checkpointing_kwargs={"use_reentrant": False},
        learning_rate=args.lr,
        warmup_ratio=args.warmup_ratio,
        fp16=True,
        bf16=False,
        max_length=args.max_length,
        completion_only_loss=True,
        logging_steps=10,
        save_strategy="epoch",
        save_total_limit=1,
        eval_strategy="epoch",
        report_to=report_to,
        seed=args.seed,
        dataloader_num_workers=2,
        remove_unused_columns=False,
        optim="adamw_torch",
        lr_scheduler_type="cosine",
    )
    if args.dry_run:
        sft_kwargs["max_steps"] = args.dry_run_steps
        sft_kwargs["save_strategy"] = "no"
        sft_kwargs["eval_strategy"] = "no"
        sft_kwargs["logging_steps"] = 1
    config = SFTConfig(**sft_kwargs)

    trainer = SFTTrainer(
        model=model,
        args=config,
        train_dataset=ds["train"],
        eval_dataset=ds["validation"],
        processing_class=tokenizer,
        peft_config=lora_config,
    )

    print("Starting training", flush=True)
    trainer.train()
    print("Training done", flush=True)

    if not args.dry_run:
        print(f"Saving adapter to {args.output_dir}", flush=True)
        trainer.save_model(args.output_dir)
        tokenizer.save_pretrained(args.output_dir)

    print("All done.", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    r"<\|im_start\|>user\n(?P<usr>.+?)<\|im_end\|>",

)

    def convert(example):
        m = _QWEN_RE.search(example["prompt"])
        if m is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Prompt does not match Qwen chat format: {example['prompt'][:200]}")
        sys_content = m.group("sys")
        usr_content = m.group("usr")
        messages = [
            {"role": "system", "content": sys_content},
            {"role": "user", "content": usr_content},
        ]
        example["prompt"] = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(

        return example

    )

        num_train_epochs=args.epochs,
        per_device_train_batch_size=args.batch_size,
        per_device_eval_batch_size=args.batch_size,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=args.grad_accum,
